create_datetimearray: create a DatetimeArray from a sequence of datetime strings with optional timezone and frequency
build_datetime_range: build a datetime range with specified start, end, periods, and frequency using DatetimeArray._generate_range
convert_timezone: convert a timezone-aware DatetimeArray from one timezone to another using tz_convert
localize_timezone: localize a timezone-naive DatetimeArray to a specified timezone using tz_localize
extract_datetime_fields: extract year, month, day, hour, minute, second components from a DatetimeArray
